title: CPSC, Hewlett-Packard Company Announce Recall of Notebook Computer Batteries
summary: An internal short can cause the battery cells to overheat and melt or char the plastic case, posing a burn and fire hazard. Units: About 135,000 battery packs worldwide, including about 85,000 in the U.S..

title: CPSC, Kelty Announce Recall of Speedster Jogging Stroller
summary: Stroller handle-locking clips can unlock during use, causing stroller to collapse. Units: 230.

title: CPSC, Polaris Industries Inc. Announce Recall of Snowmobiles
summary: The fuel tank filler neck on these snowmobiles can crack. A crack in the filler neck area may cause the filler neck to separate from the fuel tank. A crack or filler neck separation may allow fuel or fuel vapors to escape from the fuel tank, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 16,640.

title: CPSC, Bombardier Recreational Products Inc. Announce Recall of All-Terrain Vehicles
summary: The drive pulley inner flange could break, resulting in the broken flange fragments becoming projectiles. This situation could cause serious injuries or death to the rider or bystanders. Units: About 275.

title: CPSC, Design Ideas Ltd. Announce Recall of Bean Bag Furniture Sets
summary: The chair and ottoman do not have locking zippers or warning labels. CPSC is aware of children who have died from suffocation when they unzipped, inhaled and ingested small pellets in similar bean bag furniture. Units: About 1,100 sets.

title: CPSC, A.O. Smith Announce Recall of Water Heaters
summary: The water heaters can accumulate soot on the burners, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 5,000.

title: CPSC, Adjmi Apparel Group Announce Recall of Reebok Children's Fleece Pullover/Pant Sets
summary: The zipper slider and pull on the fleece pullovers can detach, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 61,000.

title: CPSC, Wal-Mart Announce Recall of Holiday Candle Gift Sets
summary: The decorative covering on the candles can ignite, posing a fire and burn hazard. Units: About 48,000.

title: CPSC, Dorel Juvenile Group USA Announce Recall to Repair Battery-Powered Ride-On Vehicles
summary: An electronic malfunction can occur in the ride-on vehicle's circuit board and/or battery connector, resulting in smoking and melting of components. This poses a vehicle fire hazard and a burn hazard to consumers, if components are touched while malfunctioning. Units: About 141,000.

title: CPSC, Delta Cycle Corp. Announce Recall of Picasso Two-Bike Folding Racks
summary: The bike racks do not have sufficient hardware to support its weight on the wall. This can cause the bike rack to unexpectedly fall, hitting a nearby consumer. Units: About 3,500.

title: CPSC, Hellenic Rug Imports Inc. Announce Recall of Shag Leather Rugs
summary: The large rugs fail to meet the federal mandatory standard for flammability, under the Flammable Fabrics Act, and could ignite, presenting a risk of burn injuries. The smaller size rugs are missing labels identifying them as flammable. Units: About 1,800.

title: CPSC, Cracker Barrel Old Country Store® Announce Recall of Miniature Musical Bells Christmas Trees
summary: The tree could overheat and melt, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 3,700.

title: CPSC, Dana Innovations Announce Recall of Amplified Volume Controls
summary: The amplifier in the keypad can overheat, posing a burn or fire hazard. Units: About 650.

title: CPSC, Far East Brokers and Consultants, Inc. Announce Safety Warning for Jack 'O Lantern Bucket Candle Holders
summary: The Halloween decoration is intended for use with a single tea light candle. If all eight candles included with the unit are lit at the same time, it can generate too much heat and pose a fire hazard. Units: About 48,500.

title: CPSC, International Comfort Products LLC Announce Recall to Repair "Packaged Gas Electric" Heating and Cooling Units, or "Gas-Packs"
summary: The unit's control board can ignite and, in certain units, can result in the ignition of flammable material adjacent to the unit. Units: About 28,700.

title: CPSC, Child Craft Industries, Inc. Announce Recall of Cribs
summary: A wooden strip added to the end assemblies of the crib to correct a spacing problem could come loose, creating a space, in violation of the federal crib standard, and posing a risk of entrapment. title: CPSC, Stihl Inc. Announce Recall of Backpack Blowers
summary: The fan wheel on these backpack blowers could break, resulting in pieces of plastic flying out of the blower housing. This poses a risk of injury to the user or a bystander. Units: About 6,230.

title: CPSC, Target Announce Recall of Jumbo Pencils with Sharpeners
summary: The sharpener's razor blade is exposed when the cover is removed. Also, the pencil sharpener hole is large enough to allow a finger to fit inside. This poses a laceration hazard to children and adults. Units: About 176,000.
